title: Design: a matrix page in view
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, so the grid has a tier column.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, three ranges.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • The title is matrix A's name with a three-dot button at the top right.
  • Under it, "Categories" with an info icon and the category names.
  • Tabs Work Order Matrix and Part Sale Matrix sit under the Categories line.
  • The grid card has an Edit button with a pencil at its top right; headers show each tier's number in small text before its name.
  • "Uses previous tier" cells are gray and italic.
  • The last range reads its start followed by " +" in view.
  • Under the grid, "Price Part Simulator" with an info icon, a Part Cost box with $ and 100, and each column's price in bold with its profit in muted text below, as in picture 3.2.
